channel.title: Somalia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Somalia, every source cited.

item.title: Somali journalists train in digital safety and ethics
item.description: Two workshops in Mogadishu and Galkayo trained 69 journalists on ethical reporting, gender equality, and digital safety.

item.title: Mawisley militias quit front lines in Hiran region
item.description: Clan fighters seize regional capital and government offices as leaders push for independent administration.

item.title: Somali party attends Arab democracy forum in Jordan
item.description: The Somali Social Solidarity Party sent its chairman and international relations representative to the October 29-30 meeting in Amman.

item.title: UN mission in Somalia closes after 30 years
item.description: The United Nations Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) ceased operations on Saturday, ending a 30-year UN presence.

item.title: Uganda begins Somalia troop pullout after 20 years
item.description: The first contingent of 109 soldiers departed Mogadishu airport on Friday, ending two decades of presence.
